text:
Yes, the duplicate-avoidance option applies to Plant Club generally, so it should apply to Collector too. You can list up to 3 plants you already own, and we'll try to avoid sending those. Keep in mind you can't choose the plant itself, so it stays a surprise.

If you already have a list on your Starter plan, the policy doesn't say whether it carries over when you change plans. I'd suggest checking it after you upgrade, or I can escalate the question to a Support Lead if you'd like confirmation.
